regulation_clause.text: Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every two years for high-risk, once every eight years for medium-risk, and once every ten years for low-risk customers, from the date of account opening or last KYC updation.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 42(1) requires periodic KYC updation at least every 2 years (high risk), 8 years (medium risk), and 10 years (low risk). 2000-CHECK-DUE's EVALUATE correctly applies >=2 for 'H' (lines 26-29), >=8 for 'M' (lines 30-33), and >=10 for any other rating including 'L' (lines 34-37), matching all three composite leaves and the at-least semantics.

provenance.annotator_notes: Human primary annotation and Claude verification agreed on this classification without final review.
